text.name: fpc_setting_walkEnabled_tooltip
text.text: Adds head movement to the on-foot first person view. Same as the keybind.

text.name: fpc_setting_walkBobScale_tooltip
text.text: How much the view rises, falls and sways with each step. Scales with how fast you are moving.

text.name: fpc_setting_walkSwayScale_tooltip
text.text: Slow drift that stops the view feeling locked to a tripod, plus breathing while you stand still.

text.name: fpc_setting_walkLandingScale_tooltip
text.text: The knee bend and nod when you land from a jump or a drop. Stronger the further you fall.

text.name: fpc_setting_vehicleEnabled_tooltip
text.text: Stops the view being welded to the cab, so it moves on a sprung seat instead. Same as the keybind.

text.name: fpc_setting_vehicleSeatScale_tooltip
text.text: How far the seat gives way under you over bumps, in corners and under braking.

text.name: fpc_setting_vehicleHeadScale_tooltip
text.text: How much your head lags behind when the machine pitches and rolls, and leans in a corner.

text.name: fpc_setting_vehicleEngineScale_tooltip
text.text: Vibration coming up through the seat. Rate follows engine revs, depth follows load.

text.name: fpc_setting_vehicleOutsideCameras_tooltip
text.text: Off by default. Turn on if you want the chase cameras to move on the suspension too.
